description: Create the actual AD inside a Google Ads ad group — this is the object that carries the creative; a campaign or ad group alone shows nothing. On a SEARCH campaign it builds a RESPONSIVE SEARCH AD: 3–15 headlines (≤30 chars), 2–4 descriptions (≤90 chars), at least one finalUrl, optional path1/path2. On a DISPLAY campaign it builds a RESPONSIVE DISPLAY AD: headlines, longHeadline, descriptions, businessName plus BOTH a landscape (1.91:1) and a square (1:1) image asset from upload_google_ads_asset. The right format is chosen from the campaign's channel. Created PAUSED and read back from Google. If the parent campaign is already LIVE (ENABLED), creating this ENABLED starts REAL AD SPEND immediately — show the user what would begin serving, get an explicit yes, then pass confirm:true. Leaving it PAUSED never needs confirmation.

adGroupId.description: the ad group this ad lives in

confirm.description: set true ONLY after the user explicitly approved starting spend — required when the parent campaign is already LIVE (ENABLED) and this object would serve immediately

customerId.description: omit to use the brand’s selected default account

descriptions.description: SEARCH: 2–4 descriptions, each ≤90 characters. DISPLAY: 1–5. Pass a plain string, or {text, pin} to pin it.

dryRun.description: true = validate with Google and create nothing

finalUrls.description: the landing page(s) — at least one is required

headlines.description: SEARCH: 3–15 headlines, each ≤30 characters. DISPLAY: 1–5. Pass a plain string, or {text, pin} to PIN one to a fixed slot (a brand name or legal line).

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id when acting through a manager account; omit otherwise

logoImages.description: DISPLAY only — logo asset resource names

marketingImages.description: DISPLAY only — landscape 1.91:1 asset resource names from upload_google_ads_asset

path1.description: SEARCH only — display-URL path segment, ≤15 chars

path2.description: SEARCH only — second display-URL path segment, ≤15 chars

squareMarketingImages.description: DISPLAY only — square 1:1 asset resource names

name: create_google_ads_ad
title: Create a Google Ads ad
